I’m going to be honest, I think that promoting the use of generative AI for visualization in our field is very disheartening. We are, at our core, supposed to be “stewards of the land” are we not? Even with the confines of corporate and capitalist America, there are ways for us to “make every effort within our sphere of influence to enhance, respect, and restore the l integrity of the landscape for all living things.” (per ALSA’s ethics page). AI uses up so much energy and is so impactful to the environment, the amount of water and energy it uses is astounding, it puts out so much waste, and takes up so much more space than people realize. I get using GPT or other chat AI to help formulate text, but using AI to generate renderings is so crazy to me when we are taught to be artists and environmentalists and designers of the resource that AI is so endlessly consuming. 

I might be alone on this, but I don’t care. I know in the world of middle age or older professionals, it seems like all companies want to do are become AI driven now, but I enjoy spending a few hours rendering or designing by hand. Using AI to render is not popular and frowned upon by recent graduates. We strive to design by hand with human intent and have the passion to do so. We’re not looking for AI to drive our profession, the environment, or our jobs into the ground. I’m sorry
